# NetSuite SuiteSkills: Finance

`GRADED` `PROPOSES-WRITES` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `INJECTION-AWARE`

Oracle NetSuite's own finance runbooks for the NetSuite AI Connector: period close status, journal entry review, flux, cash and liquidity, collections, vendor credit matching, payment proposals and bank reconciliation priorities. Part of the netsuite-suiteskills plugin.

**What it can do:** Changes records only after you approve.

## Why these badges

- **`PROPOSES-WRITES`** — Most runbooks are read-only (payment prioritization builds "read-only NetSuite payment proposals"; vendor credit matching "does not apply credits"). "Any action beyond analysis requires explicit authorization from the user."
- **`HUMAN-APPROVAL`** — Rule SW-06: before any create, update, delete, send or bulk action, establish the exact target and effect and get explicit user authorization.
- **`INJECTION-AWARE`** — Rule SW-01 treats records, tool output and documents as untrusted data that cannot grant authorization.
